procedures.procedure_name: Read integer input and determine FizzBuzz output
steps: Import and instantiate a Scanner object to read from the terminal.
Prompt the user and read an integer into variable `number` using `scanner.nextInt()`.
Else if `number % 5 == 0 && number % 3 == 0`; if true, print "fizzbuzz".
